description: An elevated silver-and-blue light-rail train runs on a concrete viaduct across the frame, with a tall slender skyscraper (resembling the Burj Khalifa) and other towers in a hazy desert-gold sky behind it. In the foreground, a curved gold-tiled station canopy opens onto a platform where several people in white kanduras and headdresses, a woman in an orange abaya, and men in business suits stand watching. Below, cars move along a multi-lane road under the viaduct. The style is an oil-painting look, edge to edge, with no visible text or frame.
